newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies turn up, speed to contract highs.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies turn up, speed to contract highs.

text.p: CME pork belly futures reversed direction and sped to contract highs in the four traded months by mid-morning as traders believed Japan will increase purchases of U.S. pork, traders said.

The buying wiped out early declines, which were the product of Friday's bearish U.S. Cold Storage report. The report showed frozen belly stocks at 54.8 million lbs, above the high end of expectations of 53.2 million lbs.
At 1038 CDT, pork bellies were up 0.275 to 1.975 cent a lb with May up 0.400 at 90.350 cents per lb. Earlier May set a contract high of 90.750 cents.
